content: Isra7eele Asa Waaye

Tana aayye ana! Woyne miththa giddofe maxishin attida miththa ayfe bone qoriza asa mala gidadis; meetettiza woyne miththa ayfey deenna; nu izas amottiza eleli gakkiza balase miththa ayfeykka beettibeenna.
Xoossas babbiza asi biitta bollafe dhaydes; suure asi issaadeyka baawa; asi wurikka suuth gussanaas zuggees; issi issi asi ba isha yarden oykkees.
Iza kushey iita ooththanaas tamaardes; dere heemmizaadey kushe genththo koyees; pirdiza daannayka matta7e ekkees; wolqqamati bana koshshidaazi ooththeettes; wurikka issi bolla duulateettes.
Istta garsafe lo7o geetettidaadey agunththa mala keehi lo7o geetettizaadey qasse kindichcho mala inttena naagizaytas wodey gakkides; Xoossa pirda gallassay gakkides; asay shirotana wodey gakkides;
ne lagge ammanoppa; ne laggenkka ammanettofa; ne ki7on nenara aqizaariska ne yootizaaz akeekada yoota.
Attuma nay ba aawa kadhana; macca naykka ba aayi bolla, naa machchaka ba bollotey bolla dendana; asas morkkey soo asa gidana.
Tani gidikko Xoossa hidota ooththays; tana ashshida ta Xoossaa naagays; ta GODAYKKA taas siyana.
Xoossafe Yida Maarota
Ta morkkezoo! Ta bolla gakkidaazi nena ufayssofo; kundikokka ta dendana; Ta dhuman uttikokka Xoossay taas poo7o gidana.
Ta iza qohida gishshas izi ta gishshas eqqana gakkanaassinne taas pirdana gakkanaas Xoossay hanqettikokka ta dandayana; izi tana poo7on kessana; tanikka iza xilloteth beyana.
Ta morkkezakka hessa beyandus; iza yeellatana. Tana, «GODAA ne Xoossay awan dizee?» gidaari kundeth ta ayfeti beyana; oge urqqa mala iza yedhettana.
Intte intte katama gimbe gimbiza wodeynne intte dhasika aassiza gallassi yaana.
He gallas asay Asooreppe Gibxe katamata, Gibxeppe Efiraaxise shaafa gakkanaas, abbafe abbaako, zumaappe zumaakko gakkanaas intteko yaana.
Istta ooso geedonne izin diza asaa gaason biittaya aykkoy bayndaaz gidana.
Galatanne Woosa
Wora giddoninne cilila maata giddon barkka dizayti ne mehe gidida ne dereta neni ne guufera heemma; beni wode mala istti Baasaaneninne Gala7aaden heemettetto.
Ne kase Gibxeppe kezida wodeza mala tani ta malata istta bessana.
Ayzaabeti hessa beyananne yeellatana; isttaskka wolqqay dhayana; istti ba doona ba kushen tuccana; istta hayththika tullana.
Biitta bollara tiran gooshettiza medheteththata mala, shooshsha mala istti biitta laaccana; ba diza gongolo giddofe kokkorishe kezana; babbishe GODAA nu Xoossako simmana; isttika inttes babbana.
Dhayshe attida zereththaa nagara atto gi maariza ne mala Xoossi oonee? Neni mernaas hanqettaka; maaro gelizayssan ne ufayettaasa.
Simmadakka nuus ne qadhettaasa; nu nagarakka ne toho garsan yedhdhaasa; nu qohozakka ubbaa gede cima abba giddo yeggaasa.
Beni wodeppe oykkada kase nu aawatas caaqo qaala ne gelida mala Yaaqoobes ammaneteth Abrahaames maaroteth ooththaasa.
